mapper.select: select rt.*, an.is_read from request_ticket rt left join admin_notification an on an.request_id = rt.id and an.receiver_role = 'ADMIN' where rt.id = #{id}

select rt.*, an.is_read from request_ticket rt left join admin_notification an on an.request_id = rt.id and an.receiver_role = 'ADMIN' where rt.requester_user_id = #{requesterUserId} order by rt.created_at desc, rt.id desc
select rt.*, an.is_read from request_ticket rt left join admin_notification an on an.request_id = rt.id and an.receiver_role = 'ADMIN' order by an.is_read asc, rt.created_at desc, rt.id desc
mapper.update: update request_ticket set status = #{status}, handled_by_user_id = #{handledByUserId}, handled_by_username = #{handledByUsername}, handled_at = #{handledAt}, handle_comment = #{handleComment} where id = #{id}
